rationale: Crosses the render-assets-and-backends family through the broad core/view/** selector and design-source-ingest through the web-compat preludes, the widget-bridge claimOverlay signature, and its regenerated bridge API artifacts. The Pulp-owned change adds a third overlay-dismissal reason beside Escape and an outside press: a press on the trigger that OPENED the open overlay closes it and is consumed, so a dropdown button toggles its own menu instead of closing it and letting the same press reopen it. route_press_to_active_overlay records the overlay trigger each press reaches and a following claim adopts it as the overlay's anchor (an instance id, never an address); View::set_overlay_anchor declares one explicitly. A press on a DIFFERENT trigger still switches menus in one press, an outside press and Escape are unchanged, and View::simulate_click on a root now routes through the same shared policy the platform hosts call. The web-compat semantic popup owner names its trigger through a new optional fourth claimOverlay argument so a keyboard-opened menu toggles too, and Enter/Space on a focused button trigger open and close its menu. Paint, layout, asset, renderer, canvas, Skia, Dawn, and authority behavior are unchanged, as is per-root ownership. Regressions are confined to test/test_overlay_routing.cpp and test/test_web_compat_overlay.cpp. No accepted expansion boundary moves and no Vellum implementation is changed; the only generated artifacts that move are the bridge signature regeneration. Registered watch-only so both families' coverage stays explicit about this overlay-dismissal change.
